title: pNetwork bridge — EVM live-extractability audit (dead Nov-2024, frozen $13.1M TVL)
closed_reasons: Erc20Vault pegOut/adminWithdraw are onlyPNetwork (single EOA per vault); all live vaults already initialized
PToken mint requires MINTER_ROLE granted to single EOAs; redeem only burns caller's own balance and relies on dead off-chain relayer
v3 PNetworkHub deployments are uninitialized/dead (factory/epochsManager/interimChainNetworkId = 0, isLockedDown reverts) — optimistic permissionless mint unreachable
v4 Adapter.settle requires TEE ECDSA signature; XERC20Lockbox releases only against caller-burned xERC20; no live collateral found
GSN meta-tx path requires gsnTrustedSigner ECDSA approval
No leaked/compromised key matches any live role-holder; no contract-mediated privileged path
key_facts: ETH vault 0x112334f50cb6efcff4e35ae51a022dbe41a48135 holds DAI 5,921.19 + BAT 44,982 + ZRX 24,989 + LRC 46,236 + PNK 79,962 + PNT 27,978 + PTERIA 950,000 (unpriced) + dust; PNETWORK=0xDffE7AC6B538B4A7Fd81c98C5fba0415d63fB132
V2-generation vaults 0xe01a9c36/0xfbc34797/0x3f22c568/0xd331e3eb/0x34d08551 are empty and already initialized
MINTER_ROLE on ETH pBTC/pOATH/pFTM = single EOA 0x0e3bde3d39ded57813f0d0727e574d16d675938b (RoleGranted blocks 14320559/14584085/14622605)
Frozen DefiLlama $13.10M (BSC 6.42M / ETH 3.46M / Ultra 3.13M) is host-chain attribution of 2024-11-29 pToken value from pnetwork.watch Grafana, not current collateral
Outstanding EVM pTokens ≈ $1.5M notional (pBTC 8.92=$757k, pGALA 94.2M=$255k, TLOS 18.05M=$297k, pLTC 303.7=$21k, pPNT 19.3M=$26k, pDOGE 149k=$14k) — unredeemable while relayer dead
9/9 fork tests PASS: unprivileged pegOut/adminWithdraw/mint/redeem/initialize all revert; PNETWORK-only pegOut succeeds; v3 hub calls revert
caveats: USD at 2026-10-04 spot prices (BTC $84,931, PNT $0.00133, GALA $0.00271, TLOS $0.01645); not Nov-2024 values
P vault figure excludes unpriced PTERIA (950,000 units) and spam tokens; exact raw balances in analysis/
S figure is notional with medium confidence (long-tail token prices/decimals); includes dead-token collateral (e.g. pSAFEMOON excluded)
UTXO-chain (BTC/LTC) and EOSIO/Algorand-side collateral out of EVM scope; BTC collateral sits in pNetwork multisig wallets (P/S)
Verdict assumes no live role-holder key is currently public; any future leak of minter/owner/PNETWORK/TEE keys re-opens extraction
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from pNetwork: every EVM release/mint path is gated by single pNetwork EOAs (vault pegOut, MINTER_ROLE, owners), the v3 optimistic hubs are dead, and the frozen $13.1M TVL is 2024 host-side notional — only ~$17k of vault collateral remains (P), plus ~$1.5M of unredeemable user pTokens (S).
